title: Marseille’s hopes dented as Liverpool wins 3–0 in Champions League clash
summary: Marseille’s push for a place in the Champions League knockout stages suffered a significant setback on Wednesday as Liverpool delivered a dominant 3–0 victory at the Stade Vélodrome. The home side struggled to convert promising moments into goals, leaving them reliant on a final league match against Club Brugge to reach the play-off round.
